# Common Indian first names, surnames and places (plan 2.5 and 4.3; fake test data, no real patients). Maharashtra
# first, then the other regions. None may be changed by matching words by sound, and none is asked about without a
# clinical word before it. client/scripts/make-word-guard.mjs adds the ones that sound like a medical word to
# realWordGuard.js.
